name: Avify
author: Alexis Valenciano

sections.description:
Avify is a platform that gives you a WhatsApp CRM, an online store (or connection to an existing one), and a point of sale system for physical stores, all in one place.

By using Avify, SMBs do not have to worry about maintaining inventory control manually since all sales channels affect a single centralized inventory.

With our technology you can receive orders and payments coming from WordPress and merge them with any other one coming from social media interaction like Instagram, Facebook or WhatsApp. You can connect your logistics, payment and billing services so that any order that enters the business can process shipping price calculations, payment or transfer receipts, and receipts or invoices automatically.

With our plugin you will be able to sync orders and online payments in WooCommerce via Avify Integration. Also, you can connect multiple card payment systems and Avify displays them at your checkout.

Contact your dedicated support channel to get your API Key and the ID of your store.

Multiple currencies

Process payments and display prices in USD, CRC, MXN.

Current version features

  • Customer data and card encryption.
  • Processing of payments in USD or CRC.
  • Sandbox testing.
  • Synchronize orders

Do you want to know more about Avify? Please visit our website and find out what we can do.
sections.installation:
• Make sure that you have at least PHP Version 7.0 and WooCommerce installed.
  • Upload the plugin zip file in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin > Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”.
  • Enable the plugin under Woocommerce > Settings > Payments.
  • Press the “Manage” button and add your provided Store ID and Client Secret.
  • To connect the orders enable in the avify dashboard Integrations > Woocommerce
sections.faq:
Does Avify generate the order in WooCommerce?

No, Avify only updates WooCommerce inventory. All orders including WooCommerce orders are managed from Avify.

Does Avify charge commissions for orders?

No, we do not have any charge for orders. Avify only charges a monthly subscription for its use and the value of the subscription varies depending on the plan each business chooses.

To know more about Avify subscription plans visit avify.com/pricing

Where can I find my dedicated support channel?

When you sign up for a monthly subscription, our customer success department will provide you a personal support channel to attend any request you have.
